Features

Your lectures,
as searchable notes

Record anything, transcribe it on your phone and find any word later, without sending a second of audio anywhere.

01 / 04
Record

Record for hours, even screen off.

Keep recording in the background with the screen off. Audio is saved every few seconds, so a dead battery can't take your lecture.

  • Unlimited recording, free
  • Crash-safe autosave
  • Bookmark key moments live
02 / 04
Transcribe

Tap any line to hear it.

Whisper runs 100% on your phone. The transcript follows the audio as it plays; tap a sentence to jump right to it.

  • Playback 0.5× to 3×
  • Skip silence, ±10 s
  • Long-press to fix any word
03 / 04
Search

Find any word in any lecture.

Search every transcript at once and jump straight to the moment it was said.

  • Search across all recordings
  • Every match highlighted
  • Starred items and folders
04 / 04
Offline

100% offline. 99 languages.

Download a model once, then transcribe with no connection. Pick fast, balanced or the most accurate.

  • English and 99 other languages
  • Picks up where it left off
  • No uploads, ever

How it works

From lecture to notes in three steps

1

Hit record

Start recording and lock your phone. Bookmark anything important as it happens.

2

Transcribe offline

OfflineScribe turns the audio into text on your phone, even in airplane mode.

3

Study and share

Search, replay any line, and export to TXT, PDF or subtitles.

Free vs Pro: Free includes unlimited recording and 60 minutes of transcription a day. Pro is a one-time purchase with unlimited transcription, the most accurate models and SRT, VTT and PDF export.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Can't find what you need? We usually reply within a day.

Contact us
Does it really work without internet?

Yes. After a one-time model download, recording and transcription run entirely on your phone.

Which languages are supported?

English and 99 other languages.

Is there a subscription?

No. Recording is free forever, and Pro is a single one-time purchase.

What if the battery dies mid-lecture?

Audio is saved every few seconds, and transcription picks up exactly where it stopped.

Can I import existing recordings?

Yes. Import audio and video files, including WhatsApp voice notes via Share.

Never miss a word of a lecture again.

Download OfflineScribe and turn your next lecture into searchable notes.
